436217.name: The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship
436217.description: Guide the Fellowship through Middle-earth's perils, where every choice echoes the weight of fate and the Ring's corruption.
436217.justification: M(4): Action points, variable powers, and multi-use cards create tactical depth. T(5): Every corruption track and heroic moment IS living Tolkien's epic. G(4): Narrative choices and fellowship management carry enormous thematic weight. F(2): Campaign setup and multiple systems add moderate overhead. Ar(5): Stunning Middle-earth artwork captures Jackson's cinematic vision perfectly.

425549.name: Moon Colony Bloodbath
425549.description: Survive the horrors lurking in a moon colony where oxygen runs low and something unspeakable stalks the corridors.
425549.justification: M(4): Action points with asymmetric powers and escalating scenario complexity. T(5): Oxygen depletion and stalking horror mechanics generate genuine dread. G(4): Every action point spent carries life-or-death consequences. F(2): Scenario setup and component management add moderate overhead. Ar(4): Atmospheric sci-fi horror aesthetic with strong thematic cohesion.

424981.name: Eternal Decks
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
424981.description: Build eternal decks across multiple lifetimes, watching your cards evolve and persist through reincarnations of strategy.
424981.justification: M(3): Deck building with multi-use cards and moderate synergy systems. T(3): Eternal/reincarnation theme present but not deeply generated by mechanics. G(3): Meaningful drafting and deck construction choices with consequences. F(2): Deck building adds setup time and card management overhead. Ar(4): Clean, atmospheric design that evokes the eternal theme effectively.

415848.name: Lands of Evershade
mechs: CAR-04 Card Draw, Limits, and Deck Exhaustion
415848.description: Delve into cursed shadow realms where light itself becomes a precious resource and ancient evils stir in the perpetual twilight.
415848.justification: M(4): Action points with evolving character abilities and multi-layered shadow mechanics. T(5): Light-as-resource and shadow corruption mechanics generate mounting dread perfectly. G(4): Every move into darkness creates meaningful risk-reward tension. F(2): Campaign setup and multiple component types add overhead. Ar(4): Atmospheric twilight artwork creates perfect gothic mood.

342942.name: Ark Nova
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
342942.description: Design the world's greatest zoo by collecting animals, building enclosures, and balancing conservation with commercial success.
342942.justification: M(4): Complex card synergies with multiple tracks and engine building. T(2): Zoo theme is decorative; mechanics reference animals without generating zoo management. G(4): Meaningful decisions in card selection, action timing, and resource allocation. F(3): Heavy game with substantial setup and complex iconography. Ar(4): Clean, professional animal photography and clear graphic design.

397598.name: Dune: Imperium – Uprising
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
397598.description: Navigate the deadly politics of Arrakis as a Great House leader, wielding spice, influence, and betrayal to claim the Imperial throne.
397598.justification: M(4): Deck-building with worker placement creates deep interlocking systems and combos. T(3): Political maneuvering feels right but mechanics reference more than generate Dune. G(4): Every card and worker placement cascades into meaningful strategic consequences. F(2): Setup and iconography density manageable but requires rules investment. Ar(4): Stunning desert palette and character art captures Dune's epic scope.

428099.name: Revenant
mechs: CAR-04 Card Draw, Limits, and Deck Exhaustion
428099.description: Return from death as a vengeful spirit to hunt down your killer while your corporeal form decays with each passing hour.
428099.justification: M(4): Action points with supernatural powers, investigation mechanics, and time pressure systems. T(5): Playing as undead spirit with decay timer generates existential horror perfectly. G(4): Meaningful choices balancing investigation speed against spiritual deterioration consequences. F(2): Campaign setup and multiple card decks create moderate overhead. Ar(4): Atmospheric gothic horror art with strong character design.

434367.name: Nippon: Zaibatsu
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
434367.description: Build industrial zaibatsu empires in Meiji-era Japan through strategic worker placement and economic development.
434367.justification: M(4): Complex worker placement with tech tracks and zaibatsu building systems. T(2): Industrial theme present but mechanics don't generate historical experience. G(4): Meaningful decisions in worker placement and corporate development paths. F(2): Euro setup overhead and rules complexity but manageable. Ar(4): Clean industrial design with period-appropriate Japanese aesthetic elements.

413246.name: Bomb Busters
413246.description: Defuse bombs in real-time silence as a specialized team racing against countdown timers before the city explodes.
413246.justification: M(3): Real-time dice selection with action queues and movement systems. T(4): Communication limits and countdown timers generate bomb disposal tension. G(3): Meaningful dice assignments under time pressure create urgency. F(2): Real-time rules add complexity but manageable thirty-minute sessions. Ar(4): Clean bomb disposal aesthetic with clear iconography and tension.

167791.name: Terraforming Mars
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
CAR-04 Card Draw, Limits, and Deck Exhaustion
167791.description: Transform the red planet into a living world by playing corporations that terraform Mars through engine-building and resource management.
167791.justification: M(4): Engine-building with card synergies, production tracks, and terraforming parameters. T(2): Mars theme decorates optimization puzzle rather than generating experience. G(4): Meaningful card plays and corporation choices shape engine development. F(2): Setup and tracking across multiple boards adds overhead. Ar(3): Functional space art but lacks atmospheric punch.

266192.name: Wingspan
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
CAR-04 Card Draw, Limits, and Deck Exhaustion
266192.description: Attract birds to your wildlife preserve by playing cards that trigger cascading engine-building combos across forest, grassland, and wetland habitats.
266192.justification: M(3): Engine-building with bird powers creating resource cascades and combos. T(2): Bird theme is lovely but mechanics don't generate nature experience. G(3): Meaningful habitat choices and card synergies with multiple paths. F(1): Elegant rules, beautiful components, quick setup and teach. Ar(4): Gorgeous bird illustrations and nature palette by Natalia Rojas.

312484.name: Lost Ruins of Arnak
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
312484.description: Lead expeditions to a mysterious island where you build decks, place workers, and uncover ancient artifacts while racing against rival archaeologists.
312484.justification: M(4): Worker placement, deck building, and research tracks create interlocking systems. T(2): Pleasant archaeology theme but mechanics don't generate exploration tension. G(4): Multiple viable paths with meaningful timing and resource decisions. F(2): Setup time and component management for dual-mechanism game. Ar(4): Solid expedition art with appealing island and artifact illustrations.

363622.name: The Castles of Burgundy: Special Edition
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
CAR-04 Card Draw, Limits, and Deck Exhaustion
363622.description: Medieval French nobles compete to build the most prosperous duchy by collecting goods, animals, and knowledge through strategic dice-driven tile placement.
363622.justification: M(4): Deep tile-laying with dice selection, set collection, and interlocking upgrade systems. T(2): Medieval duchy building exists in art but mechanics feel abstract. G(4): Meaningful dice allocation and tile placement choices with cascading consequences. F(2): Setup overhead and rulebook density create moderate friction. Ar(4): Elegant medieval artwork and high-quality special edition components.

415843.name: Puerto Rico 1897: Special Edition
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
415843.description: Govern colonial Puerto Rico, managing plantations and shipping goods while navigating the complex economics of 19th-century Caribbean trade.
415843.justification: M(4): Role selection with plantation building and shipping creates deep economic engine. T(2): Colonial theme present but mechanics don't generate historical experience. G(4): Role timing and building choices create cascading strategic consequences. F(2): Multiple boards and components with moderate setup overhead. Ar(4): Elegant historical artwork with refined production values.

343900.name: Senjutsu: Battle For Japan
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
343900.description: Master samurai clash in tactical duels where dice become weapons and every strike could be your last.
343900.justification: M(4): Dice-drafting combat with positioning, timing, and samurai-specific abilities create depth. T(3): Samurai powers and weapon dice evoke dueling but don't generate bushido tension. G(4): Every dice draft and positioning choice creates meaningful tactical consequences. F(3): Setup and component management moderate, rules density manageable. Ar(4): Beautiful samurai art and atmospheric Japanese aesthetic without miniatures.

369992.name: Warcrow Adventures
369992.description: Heroes venture through a fantasy realm battling monsters and uncovering ancient secrets in tactical dungeon-crawling adventures.
369992.justification: M(3): Action points with character progression and tactical positioning. T(3): Fantasy adventure theme adequately supported by exploration mechanics. G(3): Tactical decisions matter but within familiar dungeon-crawler framework. F(4): Large box with numerous unpainted miniatures requiring painting. Ar(3): Solid fantasy art but generic aesthetic lacks distinctive atmosphere.

399822.name: Fate: Defenders of Grimheim
399822.description: Channel the power of Fate itself to defend the last bastion of hope against an encroaching darkness that devours worlds.
399822.justification: M(4): Fate Core mechanics with aspects, stunts, and multi-use cards create tactical depth. T(5): Invoking aspects and compels IS wielding narrative fate magic against darkness. G(4): Every aspect invocation and fate point spend reshapes story outcomes meaningfully. F(2): Campaign setup and fate point tracking add moderate overhead between sessions. Ar(4): Dark fantasy aesthetic with atmospheric character and location art throughout.

413469.name: Ada's Dream
413469.description: Build and program steampunk automatons alongside Ada Lovelace to solve Victorian-era puzzles and unlock mechanical wonders.
413469.justification: M(4): Programming mechanisms with tech trees and multi-use card systems. T(3): Victorian steampunk setting pleasant but mechanics don't fully generate it. G(4): Meaningful programming decisions with cascading consequences across scenarios. F(3): Campaign setup and component management add moderate overhead. Ar(4): Elegant Victorian aesthetic with detailed steampunk machinery illustrations.

462369.name: Viticulture: Bordeaux Expansion
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
CAR-04 Card Draw, Limits, and Deck Exhaustion
462369.description: Expand your vineyard empire into the prestigious Bordeaux region, crafting legendary wines through seasonal worker placement.
462369.justification: M(4): Complex worker placement with seasonal restrictions and wine production chains. T(2): Wine theme is pleasant but mechanics don't generate winemaking experience. G(4): Meaningful placement decisions with long-term strategic consequences across seasons. F(2): Setup time and component management typical for expansion content. Ar(4): Elegant European vineyard aesthetic with quality component design.

392492.name: Stupor Mundi
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
392492.description: Lead medieval kingdoms through political intrigue, crusades, and cultural renaissance in the age of Frederick II.
392492.justification: M(4): Area control with asymmetric powers, tech trees, and multiple victory paths. T(3): Medieval politics theme present but mechanics don't fully embody it. G(4): Meaningful strategic choices across military, diplomatic, and cultural development. F(2): Medium-weight euro with moderate setup and rules complexity. Ar(4): Rich medieval artwork and quality components evoke the historical period.

408636.name: Skara Brae
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
408636.description: Lead your clan through the mystical Orkney Islands, building ancient stone circles and harnessing druidic power in prehistoric Scotland.
408636.justification: M(3): Worker placement with dice manipulation and multi-use cards. T(3): Celtic mysticism theme supported but not deeply generated by mechanics. G(3): Meaningful worker placement and resource management decisions each turn. F(2): Medium setup with dice and tile management overhead. Ar(4): Atmospheric Celtic art style with strong thematic presentation.

445048.name: SETI: Space Agencies
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
445048.description: Lead humanity's search for extraterrestrial intelligence through space exploration, technology development, and cosmic discovery.
445048.justification: M(4): Deep tech trees, multi-use cards, and interlocking space agency systems. T(3): SETI theme present but mechanics feel more like optimization puzzles. G(4): Meaningful decisions in research paths and resource allocation strategies. F(2): Complex setup and rules overhead for space simulation weight. Ar(4): Clean space agency aesthetic with atmospheric cosmic imagery.

336131.name: Halls of Hegra
336131.description: Outnumbered Norwegian defenders make their last stand against overwhelming German forces in a doomed fortress siege.
336131.justification: M(4): Action points with event deck and dice combat create tactical depth. T(5): Every action IS the desperate last stand - you feel doomed heroism. G(4): Meaningful choices about resource allocation and defensive positioning under pressure. F(2): Solo setup and rulebook density manageable but not trivial. Ar(4): Atmospheric WWII art captures Norwegian fortress and winter desperation perfectly.

391752.name: Steam Power
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
391752.description: Build steam-powered industrial empires by placing workers, upgrading machinery, and racing to harness the power of the industrial revolution.
391752.justification: M(3): Worker placement with tech tracks and engine building combos. T(2): Industrial revolution theme sits atop mechanics rather than emerging from them. G(3): Meaningful worker placement and upgrade timing decisions matter. F(2): Mid-weight setup and component management typical for euros. Ar(4): Clean industrial aesthetic with quality production values.

371330.name: Luthier
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
371330.description: Master the ancient art of violin-making, crafting legendary instruments through generations of woodworking expertise and artistic refinement.
371330.justification: M(4): Deep crafting systems with material quality, tool upgrades, and generational progression. T(2): Violin-making theme overlays euro mechanics without generating craft experience. G(4): Meaningful decisions about apprenticeships, commissions, and workshop investments. F(2): Complex rules and material management create moderate overhead. Ar(4): Elegant historical artwork and beautiful component design.

414117.name: Wroth
mechs: CAR-04 Card Draw, Limits, and Deck Exhaustion
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
414117.description: Lead survivors through a cursed wasteland where every step forward risks awakening ancient horrors that hunger for your sanity.
414117.justification: M(4): Action points with variable powers and multi-use cards create tactical depth. T(5): Curse mechanics and sanity loss generate genuine dread and desperation. G(4): Every action carries meaningful risk-reward tension in hostile environment. F(2): Setup and card management add overhead but remain manageable. Ar(4): Dark atmospheric art captures apocalyptic horror tone effectively.

350184.name: Earth
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
350184.description: Build diverse ecosystems by planting flora and fauna cards that synergize through natural habitats and elemental chains.
350184.justification: M(3): Card engine building with elemental combos and habitat synergies. T(2): Nature theme present but mechanics don't generate ecological experience. G(3): Meaningful card selection and tableau optimization decisions. F(2): Setup overhead with multiple card types and scoring tracks. Ar(4): Beautiful nature photography and clean botanical design throughout.

389031.name: Fighting Fantasy Adventures
mechs: CAR-04 Card Draw, Limits, and Deck Exhaustion
389031.description: Navigate branched narratives as classic Fighting Fantasy heroes, rolling dice against your stats to survive deadly encounters and complete epic quests.
389031.justification: M(2): Basic stat checks and branched narratives with minimal complexity. T(4): Dice-vs-stats perfectly captures Fighting Fantasy's perilous adventure feel. G(3): Meaningful story branching but limited mechanical agency. F(1): Straightforward rules, quick setup for adventure gaming. Ar(4): Classic fantasy illustrations evoke the beloved gamebook aesthetic.

465669.name: Drillers
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
465669.description: Drill deep into alien worlds, managing resources and tech upgrades while racing to extract valuable minerals before competitors.
465669.justification: M(4): Deep tech trees and resource management with interlocking drilling systems. T(3): Industrial drilling theme present but mechanics don't generate immersion. G(4): Meaningful choices in tech paths and drilling site selection. F(2): Medium complexity setup and rules overhead for weight 3.0. Ar(4): Clean industrial aesthetic with atmospheric alien world art.

445698.name: SHUG
mechs: VIC-02 Victory Points from Player Actions
445698.description: Create absurd acronyms from random letters while your friends judge which backronym makes them laugh hardest.
445698.justification: M(2): Letter constraints with creativity scoring but minimal strategic depth. T(1): Acronym theme is purely decorative word association. G(2): Creative choices matter but judging is subjective and random. F(2): Simple setup but explaining scoring takes time. Ar(2): Functional design without atmospheric or elegant visual appeal.

469532.name: Earthborne Trailblazer
mechs: VIC-01 Victory Points from Game State
469532.description: Colonize an alien planet by building settlements and managing resources across an unexplored wilderness.
469532.justification: M(2): Basic tile placement with simple resource management loops. T(1): Generic space colonization with no thematic mechanic integration. G(2): Standard optimization choices without meaningful narrative consequences. F(5): No actual game data available making this unplayable. Ar(2): Unable to assess visual design from missing information.
